bio: Kevin Jeffery Lincoln II (born October 28, 1980) is an American politician, businessman, and pastor who served as the mayor of Stockton, California, from 2021 to 2025. A member of the Republican Party, Lincoln defeated Democratic incumbent Michael Tubbs in the 2020 election.
